text: Imagine you're in the province at 3 AM. The dogs suddenly stop barking... the aswang is here.
say: Imagine you're in the province at three A.M. The dogs suddenly stop barking... the aswang is here.

text: You're on vacation at Lola's. No signal. No power. Brownout.
Everyone's asleep under the mosquito net... except Lola. Rosary in hand. Watching the window.
Before you sleep, she whispers to you. 5 rules. Follow them... and you'll make it to morning.
say: Before you sleep, she whispers to you. Five rules. Follow them... and you'll make it to morning.

text: Not every aswang looks like a monster. Some of them... look like neighbors. Kind ones. Always bringing food.
Rule number 1: listen to the tiktik. When it's loud, it's still far. When it's faint... it's on your roof.
say: Rule number one: listen to the tik-tik. When it's loud, it's still far. When it's faint... it's on your roof.

text: Rule number 2: if someone outside calls your name... don't answer. Even if it sounds like your mom.
say: Rule number two: if someone outside calls your name... don't answer. Even if it sounds like your mom.

text: Because your mom... is asleep right next to you.
Rule number 3: if a stranger knocks, asking for water... look into their eyes.
say: Rule number three: if a stranger knocks, asking for water... look into their eyes.

text: If your reflection is upside down... it's an aswang. Don't let it in.
3:30 AM. Something is moving under the house. And through the gaps in the floor... something is looking at you.
say: Three thirty A.M. Something is moving under the house. And through the gaps in the floor... something is looking at you.

text: Before the last two rules... share this with the cousin who's scared of the dark. So they're not alone.
Rule number 4: garlic on the windows, salt at the door. And Lola's stingray tail... never hide it.
say: Rule number four: garlic on the windows, salt at the door. And Lola's stingray tail... never hide it.

text: Rule number 5, the most important: if it's a manananggal... don't chase it. Find the other half of its body.
say: Rule number five, the most important: if it's a manananggal... don't chase it. Find the other half of its body.

text: Pour salt and ash on it. Before the sun comes up... it can never come back.
It screams in the sky all night long... until the rooster crows.
In the morning... there are footprints in the mud. Leading to your neighbor's house.
So if the dogs go quiet tonight... you know what to do.
